response.rationale: The presence of both elevated beta-hCG and alpha-fetoprotein levels is highly indicative of a germ cell tumor. While molar pregnancy also involves elevated beta-hCG, the additional elevation of alpha-fetoprotein points more specifically to a germ cell tumor.
